name: Aztec: The Curse in the Heart of the City of Gold

locations.note: Little Serpent, a young hunter from a village near Tenochtitlan, is accused of a nobleman's murder and races to learn what causes the plague before his parents are sacrificed, searching Tlatelolco and Moctezuma's palace.
The cult behind the disease, led by Black Flower, is found at the temple of the Ceremonial Center.
